:::{#def-vectorization}
#### Vectorization

The **vectorization**
[@wikipedia_vectorization]
of an $m \times n$ [matrix](linear-algebra.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$
is the [column vector](linear-algebra.qmd#def-column-vector) with $mn$ entries
that stacks the [column](linear-algebra.qmd#def-matrix-column)s $\matr{A}_{:,1}, \ldots, \matr{A}_{:,n}$ of $\matr{A}$ in order:

$$
\vctf{\matr{A}} \eqdef
\begin{bmatrix} \matr{A}_{:,1} \\ \vdots \\ \matr{A}_{:,n} \end{bmatrix}
$$

:::
